plan.objective: Predict INS/DEL/INV at the natural primary-chromosome event frequencies; compare to the completed length-matched sensitivity without changing its cohort.
plan.probe: Separate native balanced logistic C=1 one-versus-rest probe for each class; frozen v1 T and NT S. Native train-only scaling, validation-only temperature/F1 threshold. No tuning on test.
plan.partition: All five original chromosome folds, three checkpoint seeds and both contexts; every event and repeated anchor remains chromosome grouped.
plan.matching: No sampling or matching. Fixed L=log1p(event length) controls evaluated separately; all repeated and mixed-class anchors retained.
plan.representation: One BED first-affected-base anchor per event for every class. No END/distance/ID/donor metadata in C/S/T. Event log length is explicitly labeled L and evaluated separately.
plan.inference: Per-class one-versus-rest AP plus macro average over all three classes; paired hierarchical fold/seed bootstrap, exact fold sign-flip and BH within metric over all classes/macro, contexts and contrasts. Macro binary metrics are not joint multiclass accuracy.
validity_gates: All declared 174267 events retained; no class-dependent filtering
Complete C/S/T/H coverage and exact source/checkpoint identities
All OVR probes converge
Same test event identities in every arm/class
Full saved-prediction replay
No bin changes based on performance
limitations: Rare INV (298 events); AP must be reported with class prevalence, normalized AP and AUROC; no balanced-population interpretation
Known-SV type classification, not discovery, pathogenicity, or breakpoint detection
New anchor representation differs from original two-breakpoint INS/DEL benchmark
No DUP/complex labels in these input tables; no class relabeling
Graph donor overlap and v1 shortcut caveats remain
Static reference-segment vectors cannot distinguish events with identical features; no learned-versus-random claim
plan.population: All 174,267 primary-chromosome INS/DEL/INV events from the pinned HGSVC3 annotation tables; ascertainment conditional on that callset, not population SV prevalence.
plan.report_title: Frozen SV type: natural callset frequencies
plan.figure_title: Known SV type at natural callset frequencies: frozen encoders
plan.exploration: Predeclared after the matched-cohort results were inspected; new event denominator, not an independent resource replication.
plan.execution: One fold/seed/context smoke checks mapping, complete C/S/T/H coverage and convergence only. Scores do not choose arms. Then five fold shards, each 3 seeds x 2 contexts, exact matrix merge and saved-prediction replay.

coverage_recovery.policy: Append only missing reference embeddings from original reference-overlapping manifest windows, bypassing candidate-count filtering during frozen inference. Every preexisting vector must remain bitwise identical; original caches retained. No graph/checkpoint/model change.
coverage_recovery.targets: Full existing C/K target-segment universe, independently of event labels; both missing terminal reference segments completed in every fold/seed/context
